description: Scored crypto briefs from public chain state read through Pocket Network's own RPC endpoints, the Pocket chain and CFTC data: USDT and USDC supply by chain, crypto liquidity, CME bitcoin and ether futures positioning, on-chain ETH and BTC prices, Ethereum and L2 fees, Pocket Network health and staking. Plus address checks and unit conversion. Each brief is a 0-100 score with label, trend, drivers, risk flags, confidence and a citation for every input. Not investment advice. POST /v1/brief {vertical} returns one scored brief; POST /v1/overview returns every brief at once; POST /v1/verticals lists them. Verticals: stablecoin-supply (Is the supply of USDT and USDC growing or shrinking, and on which chains?); crypto-liquidity (Is fresh money flowing into crypto or draining out?); futures-positioning (Are institutions positioned long or short in bitcoin and ether futures?); crypto-prices (Where are ETH and BTC trading against their recent range?); network-fees (Is it cheap or expensive to transact on Ethereum and its L2s right now?); pokt-network-health (Is Pocket Network usage and participation growing?); pokt-staking (Is more POKT being staked to run the network?). Raw scored series: /v1/signals, /v1/signal, /v1/explain, /v1/catalog. Every response is a single JSON object. Research signal, not investment advice.

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/verticals, POST /v1/brief, POST /v1/overview, POST /v1/signals, POST /v1/signal, POST /v1/explain, POST /v1/catalog, POST /v1/tools/address, POST /v1/tools/units; GET /v1/version, /v1/health. JSON body only. Bad input returns 400 + JSON.

serving.backend: Node.js HTTP server (zero npm dependencies) behind a RelayMiner at http://<container>:8080. No caller auth. Answers come from a private hub refreshed by a scheduled collector of official public data; 5-minute cache.
serving.notes: Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"].
